How an 8-step n8n workflow reconciles POs & invoices

A purchase-order and invoice reconciliation flow. It catches duplicates, lets AI read the messy parts, asks a person only when confidence is low, and never fails silently. Every arrow is a live packet you can see moving.

PO & invoice reconciliation · n8n Active

1Catch duplicates

Every record gets a unique key, so nothing is saved twice.

2Let AI read the messy parts

It extracts line items and looks up approved supplier prices.

3Ask a person when unsure

Low confidence or a mismatch goes to Slack for approval.

4Never fail silently

Any error triggers an alert instead of vanishing.
